TaskDescription: Dataset B, lower-limb condition: open-loop task simulating open-loop operation of a lower-limb rehabilitation BCI, performed with the dominant lower limb only. An audible beep cued movement onset. Movement cues lasted 2.5 s and were followed by a rest interval of random duration between 5 and 6 s.
Instructions: Listen for the auditory beep and perform a brief foot movement with your dominant leg when cued; rest otherwise.
InstitutionName: Facultad de Ingeniería, Universidad Nacional de Entre Ríos (FIUNER)
InstitutionalDepartmentName: Centro de Ingeniería en Rehabilitación e Investigación Neuromusculares y Sensoriales (CIRINS)
SoftwareVersions: OpenViBE 3.6.0 (Acquisition Server, ANT Neuro eego driver) together with custom Python 3.12 acquisition software
